posts.title: A Dozen
posts.description: The author reflects on twelve years since their multiple sclerosis diagnosis, sharing the challenges and transformations experienced during this time. Initially perceived as a loss, the diagnosis led to a deeper understanding of life, vulnerability, and connections with loved ones, particularly through shared struggles with chronic illness.
